note: SCOPE: Sri Lankan kitchens in Greater London. The boundary rule is set in data/topics/sri-lankan.json - a venue counts when the Sri Lankan repertoire (hoppers, string hoppers, kottu, lamprais, sambols, devilled dishes, short eats) is the menu rather than a line on it. Kitchens that are genuinely both Sri Lankan and South Indian are recorded and labelled, not filed silently. COLLECTION: browserless, curl only. That is how the Bib Gourmand was verified first-hand rather than through a substitute.

knownGaps: Tier E is EMPTY. Reddit is blocked at reddit.com and old.reddit.com (403 to every user agent tried, including the .json API), and three mirror front ends - safereddit.com, redlib.catsarch.com and redlib.perennialte.ch - answer with a proof-of-work challenge or a 429. Four London Sri Lankan threads were visible in search results and none could be read. No non-Reddit forum with London Sri Lankan discussion was found.

No award body judges Sri Lankan cooking in Britain. Checked and empty: the Asian Curry Awards 2025 and 2024 winner lists (no Sri Lankan category and no Sri Lankan venue in any category), the National Restaurant Awards top 100 (no Sri Lankan restaurant), and Harden's, whose London cuisine pages are client-rendered. The judged evidence in this topic is the MICHELIN Guide and the Good Food Guide, and between them they cover three restaurants.

Colombo Kitchen's own site claims 'Best Sri Lankan Dining Experience' (LuxLife 2025), Sri Lankan Restaurant of the Year 2023 and National Chef of the Year 2024 (Asian Restaurant Awards), and a Guild of Fine Food 2-star Great Taste Award 2024 for its lamprais. None was verified against the awarding body, so none is printed.
Secret London says Dammika's won at the London Curry Awards in 2019. The awards' own results page was not reached, so it is not printed.

General web search collapsed mid-pass: Brave began serving a JavaScript challenge, Bing's RSS endpoint degraded to searching only the first word of a query, and DuckDuckGo lite, Mojeek, Startpage and searx.be all returned no results. Most of the corpus was collected before that, and the rest by fetching publisher and operator pages directly. A later pass with working search should look again for outer-London coverage - East Ham, Hounslow and Croydon are thin here.
openVenueQuestions: ISSO Prawn Crazy, Canary Wharf (25 Cabot Square E14 4QA) - SquareMeal writes it up as trading; the operator's own site marks the London site as opening soon. Recorded in the corpus, deliberately kept off the page until the opening is confirmed.
Yaalu Yalu, 164 Addington Road, South Croydon - named only by Eater's 2019 list. No closure signal on Time Out's venue page, but nothing recent names it either. Kept off the page.

Pavilion, Victoria Park - Eater's 2019 entry describes a meat-free cafe and bakery with Sri Lankan-INSPIRED brunches, not a Sri Lankan kitchen. The Infatuation's cuisine index still tags 'Pavilion Cafe, Bow' as Sri Lankan. Counted once, from Eater, and kept off the page on the boundary rule.
The Railway Tavern, Crouch End - tagged 'Caribbean Sri Lankan' by The Infatuation's index. Not on any list read here. Worth a look.

MOVA (Life with Hashi), Yogi's Sri Lankan Kitchen (Nandini), Malar Spice (541 High Rd, Wembley HA0 2DJ), Spicyelon (23 Wrythe Lane, Carshalton SM5 1AG), Veechu and Tharshini's each have exactly one source and no address we could confirm against an operator page.
Papaya, 161 Northfield Avenue W13 - two sources. papaya-uk.com is the Ealing restaurant; papayarestaurant.co.uk is an unrelated business in Burton Latimer.

Pamban - two sources (Time Out 2018 reader pick, Greaves) both describe a cafe in Camden's Stables Market. Pamban now trades as a packaged chai brand selling wholesale and through stockists, and its own account of the name is 'an Island with strong British ties situated between India and Sri Lanka', which is Pamban Island in Tamil Nadu. Counted in the corpus, kept off the page on both grounds: the Camden cafe could not be confirmed as trading and the Sri Lankan claim is thin.
Machan Kitchen - the operator's site lists Farringdon only, but a 'Machan Kitchen Croydon' exists on delivery platforms. Not claimed as a branch on the page.
